arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc WHERE c.description = 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant falls in the 'Grocery Stores, Supermarkets' category.
assumptions: Counts all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label, since the question asks for how many transactions, not a fraud rate.
Covers the full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
